name: core-platform-site
install:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
nvm install 22 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
nvm alias default 22 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 22)/bin:$PATH"
node -v
npm ci

terminals.name: dev
terminals.command:
export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
. "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
export PATH="$NVM_DIR/versions/node/$(nvm version 22)/bin:$PATH"
node -v
npm run dev
